detail.title: 4+4MP Active Deterrance Dual-lens Fixed-focal Entry Network PT Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-PTS1439B-E2-S-PV 4+4MP Active Deterrance Dual-lens Fixed-focal Entry Network PT Camera Key Points • Versatile Pan-Tilt for Wide-Area Security Monitoring • Dual Lenses, Double Protection. Dual 4MP Fixed and PT Lenses Protect Two Areas, Reducing Blind Spots • Smart Dual Light: Built-in IR and LED Lights with 3 Illumination Modes Supported • Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • Built-in Mic & Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk • Efficient H.264+/H.265+ Compression Technology • IP66 Ratings for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Image Sensor: Channel 1 (PT Lens): 1/3" CMOS Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): 1/3" CMOS
General.Min. Illumination: 0.008 lux@F1.6 (Color,30 IRE) 0.0008 lux@F1.6( B/W,30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Illumination Distance: Up to 30 m (98.43 ft) (IR) Up to 30 m (98.43 ft) (Warm light)
General.Lens Type: Channel 1 (PT Lens): Fixed-focal Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): Fixed-focal
General.Focal Length: Channel 1 (PT Lens): 3.6 mm Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): 3.6 mm
General.Max. Aperture: Channel 1 (PT Lens): F1.6 Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): F1.6
General.Field of View: Channel 1 (PT Lens): H: 78°; V: 42°; D: 92° Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): H: 78°; V: 42°; D: 92°
General.Close Focus Distance: Channel 1 (PT Lens): 1.5 m (4.92 ft) Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): 1.5 m (4.92 ft)
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by sub stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Channel 1 (PT Lens): Main stream: 2560 × 1440@(1–25 fps) sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480@(1–25 fps) Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): Main stream: 2560 × 1440@(1–25 fps) sub stream: 704 × 576@(1–25 fps)/704 × 480@(1–25 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–6144 kbps; H.265: 32 kbps–6144 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; audio detection; SMD; security exception
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; P2P; Auto Registration
General.Security: HTTPS; Trusted upgrade;Digest; WSSE; Account lockout; Trusted execution; Generation and importing of X.509 certification; Security logs; Trusted boot
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S & Profile G & Profile T); CGI
General.Storage: FTP; Micro SD card (support max. 256 GB)
General.Light Warning: Warm light warning Flash/Solid on duration: 5 s–180 s Flash frequency: high, medium, low
General.Sound Warning: Offers 3 sound alarms and supports importing custom sound alarms. Sound: 0-100. Play times can be set from 1 to 10.
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Channel 1 (PT Lens): Pan: 0° to 350°; Tilt: 0° to 90°; Channel 2 (Fixed Lens): Pan: 0° to 326°; Tilt: –10° to 15°
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1; CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 3.2 W (12 VDC); 4.2 W (PoE); Max.: 8.6 W (12 VDC); 10.5 W (PoE) (intelligence on + WDR + illuminator on + PT rotation + speaker on)
